text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while talking with Mejiro
Dober in my
office...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Sorry to interrupt your discussion, but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I come bearing good news for you two!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Good news?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The thing is, because of how well you
did during
your junior year...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You've been selected by the URA as
Best Junior
Year Goddess!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The title of Goddess is awarded to those
who run
in races like the Hanshin J.F.,
Triple Tiara, and
Queen Elizabeth II
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The accolade is awarded to one racer in
each
year: junior, classic, and senior. It's
a huge honor
for Mejiro Dober to be
selected to represent her
year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... I was chosen as Goddess?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can't believe it!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! ♪ The award ceremony
is going
to be held in a few days, so
don't forget to
prepare a speech!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-there's a ceremony?! And I have to
give a
speech?! I-I see, um... okay...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I know! I'm not going to get up there
without
practicing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah... I'll make sure to practice a lot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the award ceremony arrives
in the
blink of an eye...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the award ceremony arrives
in the
blink of an eye...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(It's going to be fine. I've practiced like
a hundred
times. Everything will be
fine...)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's hear a word from this year's
junior-year
Goddess, Mejiro Dober!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is immediately met with a
flood of
well-wishes and applause, as
well as flashes from
countless cameras.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uh... Um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Oh no... My mind's gone blank.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something seems off. It looks like stage
fright has
gotten her tongue all tied!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Desperate to help however I can, I start
wildly
waving my hands in her direction!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Huh? It's Trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(What is he making that desperate face
for? Idiot.
He's going to make me laugh.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(She looks so desperate, a far cry from
her usual
gorgeous face. Heh... I think
that did the trick!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I, um... I'd like to express my deepest
gratitude to
everyone today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I, um... I'd like to express my deepest
gratitude to
everyone today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm elated beyond words at having
received such
a magnificent award...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was terrifying...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Cut it with the flattery. I completely
forgot my
speech and just blurted out
whatever came to
mind up there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hardly... I forgot everything I'd prepared
and just
rambled endlessly up there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. But geez, you looked hilarious
from the
stage. You were freaking out so
much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I saw you waving, you know? You
looked
so frantic and silly, I couldn't
help smiling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Anyway... Thanks for having my back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I couldn't have done
it
without you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I hear her speech was well
received by
fans for being so sincere
despite its brevity.
